content.title: ABOUT US
content.subtitle: Our Roots are Growing Deep and Wide
content.bodyText: Daybreak Community Church knows that our strength lies not only in the words we stand by but most importantly through the actions of our initiatives. Back in 1998 we realized that by working together we could overcome our challenges much more efficiently, and that is why we ultimately decided to launch Daybreak Community Church. Please join in our quest to make a difference in the lives of our and surrounding communities. We are currently working with Lapelfoodpantry.com to reach out along with many others who have joined in as well. Along with that food pantry program we are currently serving hot meals to kids on Wednesday nights during the school year. We realize that this may be the only hot meal for some of our students. Join us as we reach our families in the community! At Daybreak Community Church we are making a difference in the hearts and minds of those that we meet. We love God! We love people! We love YOU!
content.missionPillars: Our mission to help people Know God, Grow and find freedom, Discover their purpose and gifts and then help them to Go and make a difference for God!

content.title: ACTIVITIES
content.subtitle: Making A Difference
content.classesSchedule: We teach classes on Wednesday nights for kids, teens, ladies, and men starting at 6 p.m.
content.sportsMinistry: Our sports ministry is active with over 30 young adults involved in them. Some of our activities include: Coed and Men's Softball, Coed Volleyball, 3 on 3 basketball, noodle making for the village fair, personal growth classes, game nights, bible study, prayer groups, worship nights, kids and teen camp, marriage retreat, Fall Festival/trunk n Treat, and many others.

content.title: FOOD DONATIONS DROP-OFF CENTER
content.subtitle: Helping The Community
content.description: At Daybreak Community Church, we are dedicated to stepping up our efforts in addressing this issue. Food Donation Drop-Off is by no means an easy feat, but through cooperation and community empowerment we believe we can facilitate progress in this area. We are always striving to make a difference, and invite you to learn more and lend your support. Currently, we are also picking up donations for our friends at lapelfoodpantry.com be sure to visit their page to make any monetary donations directly to them. Follow us to learn more and stay up to date on current events.

content.title: OVER SEAS MISSIONS
content.subtitle: Reinforcing our Commitment
content.description: With this initiative, our goal is to promote great opportunities for those in need. With access to the right resources, people can become empowered by their own abilities and gain the confidence to fulfill their potential. Learn more about our work by getting in touch with our team today.

content.title: Recovery Programs
content.subtitle: One Step at a Time
content.description: With our organization’s mission always in mind, we strive to find new strategies for dealing with this challenge. Sober living is something that we take very seriously, and our team is working each and every day to make a positive impact. Contact us to learn more about our commitment to this cause.

teamMembers.name: Andrew Cole
teamMembers.title: Lead Pastor
teamMembers.bio: Andrew Cole joined Daybreak Community Church with the vision and drive to improve upon our Church, and focused on developing the organization with experience and integrity.

teamMembers.name: Alex Small
teamMembers.title: Youth Pastor
teamMembers.bio: Welcome to Alex's Corner! Here, a talented individual with a deep love for Lord is dedicated to uplifting our teens through the power of music and inspiring, fun messages. Join us on a journey filled with, faith, and joy as we explore the beautiful intersection of youth and melody!

teamMembers.name: Naomi Small
teamMembers.title: Pastor of Children's Ministries
teamMembers.bio: Naomi is a truly gifted children's ministry leader who radiates love for the Lord and a passion for teaching kids. She brings joy and excitement to her lessons, engaging children through creative crafts, lively games, and uplifting music. With each message, Naomi inspires young hearts to learn about Jesus in a fun and memorable way. Her dedication makes every moment in ministry a delightful adventure for both kids and their families.
